items.title: Define and implement stable task-plus-agent identity resolution
items.context: Follow Workstream D and the shipped owner-session contract. Resolution remains explicit override, validated host-adapter task+agent identity, bounded generated fallback, then warned derived-ppid fallback. Do not use a repository-global token or collapse reviewer and implementer privileges.
items.userSees: User sees "owner session: <stable-id> [host-adapter]" remain unchanged across same-task shell boundaries; a different task or role sees the existing foreign-owner rejection.

items.title: Propagate stable identity through supported host adapters and diagnostics
items.context: Codex, Claude, and agy adapter paths must retain task and agent/role identity across child shells without exposing raw host tokens. session_brief and mutation warnings must report the identity source and degraded derived-ppid fallback.
items.userSees: User sees "session identity degraded: derived-ppid" with an actionable LATTICE_SESSION_ID/adapter hint before the first owner-gated mutation; supported adapters report their provider and source without raw tokens.

items.title: Prove isolation, compatibility, and takeover behavior with bounded regressions
items.context: Cover same task/agent across PPID changes, different tasks in one repository, implementer versus reviewer separation, explicit override, genuine foreign lease blocking, stale/active takeover, degraded warning, and supported adapter cases without live-host dependence where deterministic seams suffice.
items.userSees: User sees the same established stale/active takeover guidance for a genuine foreign lease, while same-task shell changes proceed without "foreign owner".

items.title: Ratify the canonical task-and-agent identity contract before runtime implementation
items.context: Before any runtime code change, record understanding and a structured decision with at least three adversarial pre-mortem scenarios, explicitly update or confirm the canonical owner-session identity contract, and obtain fresh review evidence from at least two independent real hosts as required by Workstream D. This decision must settle task identity, role separation, resolution priority, fallback storage/cleanup, observability, and non-goals.
items.userSees: User sees "two-host owner-session contract review: PASS (codex + antigravity; local assurance only)" before runtime implementation begins.
excludes: No runtime owner-session implementation begins before the decision and independent-host review evidence are accepted.
